chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Isa al-Farra', from Abdullah ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed ten Hajjs in concealment.
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet perform Hajj and in what manner?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) performed ten Hajj pilgrims, emphasizing the practice of 'istisrar' (concealment or quietness) to avoid the scrutiny of the Quraysh. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often interpreted not merely as physical secrecy but as a spiritual humility and a strategic avoidance of political posturing during the early Meccan period. This narrative underscores the Prophet's role as both a spiritual guide and a political leader navigating the complexities of pre-Islamic Arabian society.
